stepTitle: A $$1.80\, \text{kg}$$ falcon catches a $$0.650\, \text{kg}$$ dove from behind in midair. What is their velocity after impact if the falcon’s velocity is initially $$28.0\,\text{m/s}$$ and the dove’s velocity is $$7.00\,\text{m/s}$$ in the same direction? Give the velocity to three significant figures (in $$\text{m/s})$$.
